_comment: Build targets that are NOT hal0 catalogue rows: base images and the Vulkan server lineage moved here from Hal0ai/amd-strix-halo-toolboxes. They are kept out of images.json on purpose, because hal0's runner-image sync turns every images.json entry into a slot-selectable row. build-matrix.yml builds these ONLY via workflow_dispatch (`only` = the id). Every push goes to a NEW package under ghcr.io/hal0ai/ and a NEW immutable tag `<tag_prefix>-<llama_ref[:7]>-r<recipe commit[:7]>`; the workflow refuses to push if that tag already exists and never pushes a floating tag. `consumed_ref` is the image hal0 uses today; nothing switches to a build from here until a planned bump re-gates it (docs/CONSOLIDATION.md).

recipes.notes: Base FROM'd by every runners/* recipe ([base] digest). llama_ref derived from the consumed digest's embedded build-info (strix-base/README.md).
hal0 FALLBACK_VULKAN_IMAGE lineage (consumed by floating tag; observed sha256:33004bf0... on 2026-10-04). llama_ref derived from that image's embedded build-info (llama-vulkan/README.md).
